query: INSERT INTO social_media_category_settings (streamer_login, twitch_user_id, category_key, auto_post, updated_at, updated_by) SELECT twitch_login, twitch_user_id, $2, $3, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, $4 FROM twitch_streamers WHERE twitch_user_id = $1 ON CONFLICT (twitch_user_id, category_key) WHERE twitch_user_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET streamer_login = EXCLUDED.streamer_login, auto_post = EXCLUDED.auto_post, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
